title: Speakeasy Enchantments
description: Enchantments heavily inspired by Hypixel Skyblock
body:
**Speakeasy Enchantments** brings Hypixel Skyblock-inspired enchantments (plus original custom enchants) into vanilla Minecraft with fully custom mechanics, while remaining a lightweight and performance-friendly mod.

### ✨ Normal Enchantments:
###
• **Aiming** — Arrows curve toward nearby targets  
• **Blessing** — Chance to grant bonus fishing loot, with GOOD / GREAT / OUTSTANDING tiers  
• **Cubism** — Bonus damage to Slimes, Creepers, and similar mobs  
• **Delicate** — Prevents breaking crops that are not fully grown  
• **Ender Slayer** — Increased damage to End mobs  
• **Experience** — Gain bonus XP from mining and combat  
• **First Strike** — Deal extra damage on the first hit  
• **Growth** — Increases max health  
• **Life Steal** — Heal on hit (balanced to prevent abuse)  
• **Magnet** — Grants bonus XP orbs when fishing  
• **Momentum** — Gain Haste when mining continuously  
• **Quick Bite** — Fish bite faster after approaching the bobber  
• **Replenish** — Automatically replants harvested crops  
• **Smoldering** — Bonus damage to Nether mobs  
• **Snipe** — Distance-based bow damage scaling  
• **Sugar Rush** — Increases movement speed  
• **Transmutation** — Chance to convert nearby blocks into ores  
• **Tread Lightly** — Prevents farmland trampling  
• **Thunderlord** — Lightning strikes every 3rd hit or on mace slam  

### 🔥 Ultimate Enchantments: ###

• **Bobbin’ Time** — Builds stacking fishing momentum that boosts catch speed and treasure chances over time  
• **Fatal Tempo** — Landing hits grants Ferocity-style follow-up strikes with visual slash effects  
• **Legion** — Scales stats based on nearby players  
• **Rend** — Arrows apply stacks that can be detonated for bonus damage  

### 🎯 Designed for:
• Hardcore gameplay  
• Modpacks with tougher mobs  
• Players who enjoy progression-based combat  

⚡ Balanced for vanilla, but shines in modded environments.

💡 Inspired by enchantments from Hypixel Skyblock, reimagined for vanilla and modded Minecraft.

---

This is my first mod I've ever made and I'm trying to keep it as updated as possible — feedback and suggestions are always welcome 😊
